slides.heading: Don't say yes to these at your car service
Ask for a written estimate first

voice_lines: Before any work starts, ask for a written estimate, and tell them to call you before adding anything extra. Ask to see the old parts too.
Question these add-ons: an engine flush every service, throttle cleaning every time, an AC gas top-up without a leak check, and paid nitrogen.
Your owner's manual says what's actually due, by kilometres or months. If it's not due, you can say no.
Ask why, then decide. Most add-ons are optional. Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram.
caption:
My simple rule at every car service: ask why before you pay 🔧

1. Get a written estimate before any work starts.
2. Tell them to call you before adding anything extra.
3. Ask to see the old parts.

Add-ons worth questioning: engine flush every service, throttle or injector cleaning every time, AC gas top-up without a leak check, paid nitrogen top-ups.

Your owner's manual lists what's actually due by km or months. Not every add-on is a scam, but you should know why you're paying for it. Save this for your next service.

Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram 👇
